caption: Check the post and page counts before import.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['wordpress-wxr-import']; const file=app.vault.getFileByPath('WordPress WXR Import/demo.xml'); if(!file)throw new Error('Missing sample XML'); const xml=await app.vault.read(file);p.pro.signOut();window.__wxrModal=p.openImport();const input=window.__wxrModal.contentEl.querySelector('input[type=text]');input.value='Preview import';input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));const transfer=new DataTransfer();transfer.items.add(new File([xml],'Field journal.xml'));window.__wxrModal.contentEl.querySelector('input[type=file]').files=transfer.files;await window.__wxrModal.selectFile(transfer.files[0]); return 'ok';})()

caption: Keep source IDs, dates, author, categories, and tags.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['wordpress-wxr-import']; const file=app.vault.getFileByPath('WordPress WXR Import/demo.xml'); if(!file)throw new Error('Missing sample XML'); const xml=await app.vault.read(file);p.pro.signOut();if(!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Demo import'))await p.importXml(xml,'Demo import');await app.workspace.openLinkText('Demo import/Field journal-11.md','',false); const view=app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf()?.view; if(view?.leaf)await view.leaf.setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:view.file.path,mode:'preview'}});return 'ok';})()

caption: Read the converted body and its approved comment.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['wordpress-wxr-import']; const file=app.vault.getFileByPath('WordPress WXR Import/demo.xml'); if(!file)throw new Error('Missing sample XML'); const xml=await app.vault.read(file);p.pro.signOut();if(!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Demo import'))await p.importXml(xml,'Demo import');await app.workspace.openLinkText('Demo import/Field journal-11.md','',false); const view=app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf()?.view; if(view?.leaf)await view.leaf.setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:view.file.path,mode:'preview'}});await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(r)));const active=app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf()?.view;const heading=[...active.containerEl.querySelectorAll('h2')].find(h=>h.textContent==='Approved comments');if(!heading)throw new Error('Missing approved comment heading');heading.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return 'ok';})()

caption: Save a folder and field mapping profile with Pro.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['wordpress-wxr-import']; const file=app.vault.getFileByPath('WordPress WXR Import/demo.xml'); if(!file)throw new Error('Missing sample XML'); const xml=await app.vault.read(file);p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('wordpress-wxr-import-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36));await p.pro.refreshNow();await p.saveProfile({name:'Blog archive',folder:'Next archive',mapping:{author:'writer'}});window.__wxrModal=p.openImport();let dropdown=window.__wxrModal.contentEl.querySelector('select');dropdown.value='0';dropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));window.__wxrModal.contentEl.querySelector('details').open=true;window.__wxrModal.contentEl.querySelector('select').value='0';return 'ok';})()

caption: Review changed and removed source IDs with Pro.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['wordpress-wxr-import']; const file=app.vault.getFileByPath('WordPress WXR Import/demo.xml'); if(!file)throw new Error('Missing sample XML'); const xml=await app.vault.read(file);p.pro.signOut();if(!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Demo import'))await p.importXml(xml,'Demo import');p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('wordpress-wxr-import-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36));await p.pro.refreshNow();window.__wxrModal=p.openImport(true);const inputs=window.__wxrModal.contentEl.querySelectorAll('input[type=text]');inputs[0].value='Next review';inputs[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));inputs[1].value='Demo import';inputs[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));const later=xml.replace('Our first field visit.','Our second field visit.').replace(/<item><title>Contact[\s\S]*?<\/item>/,'');const transfer=new DataTransfer();transfer.items.add(new File([later],'Later export.xml'));window.__wxrModal.contentEl.querySelector('input[type=file]').files=transfer.files;await window.__wxrModal.selectFile(transfer.files[0]); return 'ok';})()
